test_title: PYST 5: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

He said, “I have never seen anything like that before”.

options.text: He said that he didn’t see anything like that before.
He said that he had never seen anything like that before.
He said that he was never seen anything like that before.
He said that he has never seen anything like that before.

solution:
The correct answer is **'option 2'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The reporting verb ("**said**" in this case) is changed to the past tense.
 
• Pronouns may change to reflect the perspective of the reported speech.
 
• Tenses may shift depending on whether the reported speech is in the present, past, or future tense.
 
• In this sentence, the reporting verb "**said**" is already in the past tense, so we don't need to change it. 
 
• The pronoun "I" changes to "**he**" to reflect the perspective of the person reporting the speech. 
 
• The verb "**have**" changes to "**had**" to shift the tense from present perfect to past perfect, indicating that the action occurred before the time of reporting.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

the correct transformation of the given sentence into indirect speech is:*** "He said that he had never seen anything like that before."***

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1** is inappropriate as the simple past tense is used which is incorrect.
 
• **Option 3** is inappropriate as the sentence is changed from active to passive voice.
 
• **Option 4 **is inappropriate as the sentence is in present perfect tense.
